author: Bobbbyb80193
title: Do not waste your time!
content:
Quick Hit Slots is a perfect example of a game that looks flashy but delivers almost nothing enjoyable underneath it. The bright graphics and casino sounds are there to pull you in, but the actual experience gets frustrating fast. Instead of feeling rewarding or entertaining, it feels like the entire game is built around keeping you clicking, waiting, and coming back for another disappointing spin.

The fun disappears quickly, progression feels unrewarding, and after a while you realize you’re spending more time hoping the game becomes enjoyable than actually enjoying it.

There are far better slot games out there. Save your storage space, save your time, and skip this one.

If I could give it zero stars, I would.

That being said, jackpots almost NEVER hit. As an experiment, on multiple occasions, I’ve done back to back to back purchases on multiple games, and lost it all in a matter of minutes. That’s while betting the minimums. I’ve spent a lot of money on this game, to see if it’s possible to build a coin bank roll. It’s not. I had high expectations for this app, but all it’s done is take my money, and leave me in a position to where I have to spend more. Sad.
